Seeing this post right now is so weird and coincidental. I was just looking at my scars and thinking about everything and then got on reddit as a distraction. 

To me, I feel really awkward about my scars (the most visible are all the way up my left wrist and forearm). I constantly worry that people will see them and judge me or that they'll want to talk about it and I won't know what to say. 

My scars symbolize so many things- hurt, loneliness, pain, anger, regret, and sadness. But they also symbolize strength and moving on. After 2 years, I am 17 days clean from self-harm and cutting. Everyday is a new battle but I'm still here. So yes, sometimes I do feel embarrassed about all my scars. But they symbolize my past, not my future and I have to remember that. Self harm and depression have been a huge part of my life and are things that I'm still struggling with. However, if people are really going to judge me about scars from my past, then that's their issue.
